segments: First Generation: The Patriarchs.
And on the seventh of Iyyar, at the turn of the year, they came out of the ark.
And they left it in Apamea, the metropolis of Pisidia,
as Josephus said.
The years from Adam to the Flood total two thousand two hundred and forty-two.
And then Noah divided the earth among his three sons.
The territory of Shem:
Persia and Bactria {OCR?}, as far as India and Rhinocorura.
And his sons are the Assyrians,
the Chaldeans,
the Lydians (the Illyrians),
the Syrians,
the Hebrews,
the Persians.
The territory of Ham:
from Rhinocorura as far as Gadeira.
And his sons are the Indians,
the Egyptians,
the Aegyptians,
the Hittites,
the Jebusites,
the Hivites,
the Amorites,
the Girgashites,
the Arvadites.
The territory of Japheth:
from Media to Gadeira, the northern side.
And his sons are the Macedonians,
the Armenians,
the Medes,
the Greeks,
the Gauls (or Latins) {OCR?},
the Romans,
the Iberians.
After Noah, Shem his son, at the age of one hundred and one years, begot Arpachshad.
All his days were two hundred years {OCR?}.
After Shem, Arpachshad {OCR?} his son.
At the age of one hundred and thirty years, he begot Cainan.
All his days were four hundred and sixty-five years.
After Arpachshad:
Cainan his son, at the age of one hundred and thirty years, begot Shelah.
All his days were four hundred and thirty years.
This Cainan and his years Eusebius does not reckon in the succession of years,
nor does the Hebrew book, nor our Syriac one;
Luke, however, mentions him in the Gospel.
And as it is said:
He discovered Chaldean astrology {or wisdom},
and his sons worshipped him as a god,
and they set up an image for him;
and from here began the worship of images.
And he built the city of Harran after the name of Haran, his son.
At the age of one hundred and thirty years, he begot Eber.
All his days were four hundred and sixty years.
At the age of one hundred and thirty-four years {OCR?}, he begot Peleg.
All his days were three hundred and forty-three years {OCR?}.
And it is said:
that from him the Hebrews were named.
At the age of one hundred and thirty years, he begot Reu.
All his days were three hundred and forty-three years {OCR?}.
And in his one hundred and first year, the first king reigned in Egypt, Panophis, for sixty-eight years.
And in the one hundred and fortieth year of Peleg, the earth was divided again, a second division, among the sons of Noah.
And to the sons of Shem...
